headline: Globant Expands Buyback Program After Cutting Full-Year Guidance
summary: Globant announced an expansion of its share buyback program after lowering its full-year guidance for revenue and net income. The Argentine IT services company reduced its total workforce by 8.9% over the past year.
why: Globant is a global digital services and software development firm originating from Argentina.

impacts.name: Globant
impacts.why: Lowering annual earnings guidance signals weakening client demand for software consulting services.
